sources.notes: The review asks which application tasks are reliable, so discovery must separate training-time/offline assistance, policy evaluation, recovery, planning, and direct control, and must include counterevidence on action fidelity, physical adherence, long-horizon drift, and latency.

queries.label: dynamic-world-model-policy-evaluation
queries.query: all:"world model" AND all:"policy evaluation" AND all:robot
queries.why: Test whether policy ranking and scalable evaluation have the strongest sim-real evidence.

queries.label: dynamic-world-model-data-synthesis
queries.query: all:"world model" AND (all:"data synthesis" OR all:"synthetic demonstrations") AND all:robot
queries.why: Cover training-time generation and augmentation, where model errors are filtered before deployment.

queries.label: dynamic-world-model-post-training-recovery
queries.query: all:"world model" AND (all:"post-training" OR all:recovery OR all:"self-correction") AND all:robot
queries.why: Cover failure-adjacent correction and policy post-training rather than unconstrained generation.

queries.label: dynamic-world-model-planning-control
queries.query: all:"video world model" AND (all:planning OR all:control) AND all:robot
queries.why: Find direct planning/control evidence and its deployment constraints.

queries.label: dynamic-world-model-admissibility
queries.query: all:"world model" AND (all:"action fidelity" OR all:"physics adherence" OR all:"failure optimism") AND all:robot
queries.why: Test whether visual realism is insufficient for decision use.

queries.label: dynamic-world-model-long-horizon-efficiency
queries.query: all:"world model" AND all:robot AND (all:"long-horizon" OR all:latency OR all:efficiency)
queries.why: Cover compounding rollout error and online inference cost.

queries.label: dynamic-world-model-geometry-distillation
queries.query: all:"world model" AND (all:4D OR all:geometry OR all:"point track") AND all:"robot manipulation"
queries.why: Cover training-time geometry supervision and distillation that may improve policies without online rollout cost.

queries.label: dynamic-world-action-model-contact
queries.query: (all:"world action model" OR all:"video world model") AND (all:contact OR all:tactile OR all:force) AND all:robot
queries.why: Check reliability boundaries for contact-rich manipulation and partially observed physics.

browser_fallback_queries.label: dynamic-reliable-world-model-tasks-browser
browser_fallback_queries.query: site:arxiv.org/abs 2026 robot video world model policy evaluation data synthesis recovery planning
browser_fallback_queries.why: Discover newly submitted task-oriented papers if the API under-recovers.

web_calibration_queries.label: dynamic-world-model-neural-simulator-web
web_calibration_queries.query: site:arxiv.org/abs 2026 robot neural simulator world model policy evaluation
web_calibration_queries.why: Calibrate current naming around video-world-model evaluators.
